title: Santiago
description: Santiago's mod, with thematic items and a complete in-game python script runner!
body:
# Santiago's Mod

Full of Santiago's iconic thematic items, a set of tools and armor, workstations and a computing/scripting module!

## Santiaguita

### Workstations

Includes a new processing method and a new crafting bench, both with support for data-driven recipes

### Ore

A new rare material, complete with a set of armor and tools that requires the use of the mod's workstations.

## Computing

Adds a computer and scripting tools, allowing you to write Python scripts from the game and integrate different computers using EnderCards. Has full support for redstone to be integrated into farms and contraptions.
